What is AI External Memory?

AI external memory refers to dedicated storage mechanisms and techniques that AI agents use to retain information beyond their immediate processing context or the finite capacity of their internal models. item.title: AI Agent Persistent Memory: Enabling Stateful Agents with Long-Term Recall
